title: Agent Overlay UI
notes: All 6 stories implemented + verified headlessly. Visual pywebview window must be verified by the user on the host.

stories.title: Cancel-flag pipeline gate
stories.rationale: Overlay-driven cancel needs a way to push InterruptionFrame from outside the pipeline. Mirror the mute-gate flag-file pattern.
acceptanceCriteria: src/config.py Settings has cancel_flag_file: Path defaulting to HEARE_HOME / 'cancel.flag'
src/pipeline/stages/cancel_flag_gate.py defines create_cancel_flag_gate(flag_path: Path) returning a FrameProcessor
On every frame, gate checks flag_path.exists(); when True it deletes the flag and pushes InterruptionFrame upstream exactly once; all frames pass through unchanged
src/pipeline/build.py imports and inserts the cancel_flag_gate into the stage list (after input_mute_gate, before audio_event_observer)

tests/test_cancel_flag_gate.py covers: (a) flag absent => no InterruptionFrame; (b) flag present => InterruptionFrame pushed upstream, flag deleted, original frame still forwarded; (c) flag re-created after delete => fires again
uv run pytest tests/test_cancel_flag_gate.py exits 0

stories.title: Overlay FastAPI server
stories.rationale: Single-process backend the pywebview window talks to. Reads daemon state files, writes flag files.
acceptanceCriteria: src/overlay/server.py exposes a create_app(settings) -> FastAPI factory
GET /api/state returns JSON: {voice_state, audio_event, mute_output, mute_input, daemon_online}. daemon_online=true iff voice_state_file mtime is within 10s.
POST /api/mute/output {on: bool} toggles settings.mute_file; returns {muted: bool}
POST /api/mute/input  {on: bool} toggles settings.mute_input_file; returns {muted: bool}
POST /api/cancel touches settings.cancel_flag_file and returns {ok: true}
GET / serves static/index.html; GET /static/* serves the static directory
tests/test_overlay_server.py uses fastapi.testclient.TestClient and tmp_path settings to exercise all 5 routes; uv run pytest tests/test_overlay_server.py exits 0
Server binds 127.0.0.1 only (verified in code, not just doc)
stories.evidence: 8/8 tests pass in tests/test_overlay_server.py; bind_host() returns '127.0.0.1'

stories.title: Overlay static frontend
stories.rationale: Minimal HTML/CSS/JS that the pywebview window renders.
acceptanceCriteria: src/overlay/static/index.html exists and contains: status pill, transcript region, three action buttons (mic mute, output mute, cancel), debug accordion
src/overlay/static/overlay.css styles frameless/translucent body and the four UI regions
src/overlay/static/overlay.js polls /api/state every ~200ms, renders state, wires three POST handlers, pauses polling on document.hidden
All three POST endpoints are referenced by overlay.js with correct paths
stories.evidence: Files present; test_index_route_serves_html confirms index.html is served and contains <title>heare</title>; overlay.js references /api/mute/input, /api/mute/output, /api/cancel

stories.title: pywebview launcher + optional dep group
stories.rationale: One-process entry point; pywebview opens the window pointed at the local server.
acceptanceCriteria: pyproject.toml has [project.optional-dependencies].overlay including pywebview, pyobjc (darwin-only), fastapi, uvicorn
src/overlay/app.py defines run() that: imports settings, starts uvicorn on 127.0.0.1:RANDOM in a daemon thread, then calls webview.create_window + webview.start with on_top=True, frameless=True
src/overlay/__main__.py invokes app.run() and prints a clear hint if pywebview/fastapi imports fail

Headless smoke: python -c 'from src.overlay.server import create_app; from src.config import load_settings; create_app(load_settings())' exits 0 (proves server side imports + factory work without pywebview installed)

stories.title: hearectl overlay subcommand
stories.rationale: Match daemon ergonomics so the overlay starts/stops the same way.
acceptanceCriteria: hearectl gains an 'overlay' subcommand that launches python -m src.overlay in the background and writes $HEARE_HOME/overlay.pid
hearectl gains an 'overlay-stop' subcommand that reads overlay.pid and TERMs the process
Running 'hearectl' with no args lists 'overlay' and 'overlay-stop' in the help/usage output
bash -n hearectl exits 0 (syntax check)
stories.evidence: bash -n exits 0; help output lists 'overlay' and 'overlay-stop'

stories.title: README / docs update
stories.rationale: Document the new feature so the user can find it.
acceptanceCriteria: README.md adds a section 'Overlay UI' explaining: install via 'uv pip install -e .[overlay]', launch via 'hearectl overlay', what each button does, and the file-flag contract
.omc/plan-overlay-ui.md status flipped from 'draft' to 'implemented' with a brief retrospective note (drift from plan, if any)
stories.evidence: README has new 'Overlay UI' section between 'Watch dashboard' and 'Browser bridge'; plan-overlay-ui.md status='implemented' with retro section
